recommendations.why: 3 replicas and no PodDisruptionBudget: evictions are ungoverned, so the API server cannot pace a drain for this workload.
recommendations.fix:
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: play-cache
  namespace: dencer-demo
spec:
  maxUnavailable: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      # check this matches every pod of this workload, and only those
      app: play-cache
